title.ko: 연설문: 청중 호명 · 3의 법칙 · 수사 의문문 · 호소
title.en: writing speeches: addressing the audience, rule of three, rhetorical questions and calls to action

explain.ko: 연설문은 청중을 설득하고 감동시키기 위해 쓰는 글로, 구어적 리듬과 수사 기법이 중요합니다. 인사(Ladies and gentlemen), 구성 안내(I want to speak about three things), 3의 법칙(courage, responsibility and the future), 수사 의문문(If not now, when?), 반복(We will ... We will ...), 호소(Let us ...)를 활용합니다. 문장은 짧고 리듬감 있게 쓰고, 마무리에서는 행동을 촉구합니다.
explain.en: A speech is written to persuade and move an audience, so spoken rhythm and rhetoric matter. Use greetings (Ladies and gentlemen), signposting (I want to speak about three things), the rule of three (courage, responsibility and the future), rhetorical questions (If not now, when?), repetition (We will ... We will ...) and appeals (Let us ...). Keep sentences short and rhythmic, and end with a call to action.

notes.ko: 연설은 눈으로 읽는 글이 아니라 귀로 듣는 글이므로 문장을 짧게 쓰세요.
notes.en: A speech is heard, not read, so keep sentences short.

notes.ko: 수사 기법은 너무 많이 쓰지 말고 핵심에 사용하세요.
notes.en: Use rhetoric sparingly, for key points.
Choose a tone suited to the audience and occasion.

lines.t: Good speeches use several techniques. First, the rule of three repeats three points. Second, rhetorical questions address the audience. Third, a call to action in the ending.
